# Changes to the Oneiroi firmware copy

As of Milestone 0 there are NO changes: every firmware file is a byte-for-byte copy of Befaco/Oneiroi at the commit
named in SOURCE.txt. The workflow checks this file by file on every build.

Rule for later milestones: any change to a firmware file is marked in that file with the words "AetherUmbra change"
and the file is listed below with a short reason. The workflow fails if a changed file is not marked and listed.
